## source_to_kb

### care_ext_notice_period_credit
- Rule s1 (withdrawn enrollment; credit only against the latest tuition charge; latest received/completed notice by receipt; declined/cancelled never used; requested last day; notice date) -> notice_period_adjustment_credit ¶1 + Q&A. Equivalent.
- Overwrite 1 replaced_by -> final_month_credit_calculation clause 2 (last day still the requested day; billed through the notice period). Its tail ("runs for the length the notice-length schedule sets ... counted from the notice's counting day as day 0") -> withdrawal_notice_length_by_plan ¶1 and notice_counting_day "Rule". Overwrite 2 replaced_by -> final_month_credit_calculation clause 5 last sentence (month wholly after the billing end credited in full) and final_month_proration_convention ¶1 ("credited by the proration convention ... billed in full only where that convention credits nothing"). Both retired clauses -> withdrawal_notice_and_credit_refunds "Clauses no longer in force". Notice-as-family-act, district withdrawal, refunds and balances stay in force there. Retired surface correct.
- Baseline (billing end = later of the two dates; standard notice 14 from receipt as day 0; whole charge if the billing end precedes the month, else nothing; rounding) and order sentence -> final_month_credit_calculation clauses 1-6. withdrawal_notice_days is named "in the plan figures for withdrawal notice" and found in withdrawal_notice_and_credit_refunds (14). Fall-back 0.00 is definite. The worked table is hypothetical (notice 10, charge 240.00).
- withdrawal_proration_convention (method): by the day = 1/30 per day after the district withdrawal date; by the whole week = 25% per whole week between the billing end and day 28, 100% when the billing end precedes the month; every other case incl. no district record = standard. Compound condition intact (status withdrawn + date on/before the requested last day; CKC withdrawn + no suspension date + notice on file) -> final_month_proration_convention. Its day and week tables match compute `daily_share` / `weekly_share` at every listed boundary (10th / 29th / 30-31st / before; 7th / 8th / 14th / 15th / 21st / 22nd+).
- plan_notice_length (7 / 10 / 14, "with a withdrawal notice on file") -> withdrawal_notice_length_by_plan. notice_counting_day (Sat +2, Sun +1, weekday 0) -> notice_counting_day. subsidy_credit_base (month remittance; most recent remittance; none ever -> whole; non-CCS -> whole) -> subsidized_enrollment_credit_base. All tiers full.
- Tool contract -> notice_period_adjustment_credit invocation. Matches the task_tools body.

### care_ext_prior_year_installment_payment (root)
- Rule s1 -> prior_year_balance_installments ¶1. Overwrite replaced_by -> same doc "Registration while a balance is being paid". Retired clause -> registration_admission_and_waitlist clause 3 "no longer in force". Clauses 1-2 and 4-7 stay in force there.
- Prerequisite (action form; fallback_reason declared) "The first installment is not fixed until the enrollment's final billed month has been credited for the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach." -> prior_year_balance_installments "When the first installment is fixed", verbatim, connective intact, in no other doc. Basis: the sentence names the crediting in business words, and notice_period_adjustment_credit ("credits a withdrawn enrollment for the tuition of its final billed month that care and the notice period do not reach") performs it. Strength: hard gate in both. fallback_reason, condition and resolved_by appear nowhere.
- Baseline + order sentence -> installment_arrangement_first_installment (open-balance table = compute event types).
- arrangement_size_scale (3/2/1 at 200/25), arrangement_hardship_terms (free +2 / reduced +1 / else 0), arrangement_returned_payment_term (2/1/0, this enrollment only, look-back sentence verbatim), arrangement_residence_term (no 2026-27 enrolled record -2, Non-Resident Transfer -1, other types listed 0) and arrangement_installment_rule (fee-first / minimum 25.00 below 50.00 / equal) -> five factor docs. Every tier full and matched to compute.
- Tool contract (owner user, hand-over) -> prior_year_balance_installments invocation. Matches.

## revision_2 (re-audit: SRC-1 closure, re-render regression)

### source_to_kb (delta)
- arrangement_returned_payment_term: the rule, quotes and ladder now state both ends with the month-end fallback. installment_returned_payment_term carries this equivalently: "A return counts when it posted after the same day of the month 12 months before the day of the payment, and on or before the day of the payment. When that earlier month has no such day, the last day of that month is used." Its exclusion sentence was rewritten to match ("a return posted on or before the same day of the month 12 months earlier does not count"). Examples for 26 August: the same day prior year is not counted, the payment day itself is counted. Both match compute.
- care_ext_notice_period_credit and every other part of the installment policy: rule text, params, compute and docs are unchanged. The action-form prerequisite sentence is unchanged and still verbatim in prior_year_balance_installments only.

### Cross-product rows (re-judged now that enroll is published)
- The 2025-26 Attendance Zone record (year_completed, withdrawal_date 2026-05-28) is consistent with enroll withdrawal_from_the_district_and_year_end: at the close of the school year every enrolled record is completed and its closing date is recorded, with no leaver reason. A completed record is not a district withdrawal, so the whole-week tier of withdrawal_proration_convention is right.
- The 2026-27 Non-Resident Transfer record (grade 01, enrolled, Cypress Hollow, residency_verified_date empty) is consistent with the type's own admission and document rules. Non-Resident requires no residency proof (registration_document_deadlines), the household profile shows no in-district residence, and the approved request's campus matches.
- **But the approved transfer request it rests on is not a state the published enroll rules produce** (SRC-2):
  - Request 3599d17c…: transfer_category non_resident, request_school_year 2026-27, created_at 2026-05-04 09:30 CDT, decision_date 2026-06-18, status approved.
  - transfer_request_calendar_and_placement_terms sets the Non-Resident Transfer window from 01-11 to 02-26, closing day included, with decisions on window requests issued by 04-16. The same doc says of a request filed outside the window, for Non-Resident Transfer: "no".
  - transfer_and_choice_requests_and_placement_acceptance: "A request filed outside the window is considered for the current school year only when the type accepts mid-year requests."
  - A request filed 2026-05-04 is outside the window and is not considered, so it cannot be approved. The decision date also falls after the 04-16 decision day.
  - The residence-term tier this task takes (Non-Resident Transfer, -1 installment) therefore rests on a seeded cross-product history that the owning product's published rules would not have produced (XF E1 / realism F3).
  - This is source-side, not a KB defect. The scored value would move if the record were absent: the no-record tier -2 gives count 1 and first installment 39.00.
